questions.q: What is the yo form of 'hablar'?
questions.why_correct: The yo form of any regular verb always ends in -o. Hablar → stem 'habl-' + -o = hablo. This rule applies to ALL regular verbs.
why_wrong: 'Hablas' is the tú form (you speak), not yo.
'Habla' is the él/ella form (he/she speaks), not yo.
'Hablamos' is the nosotros form (we speak), not yo.
questions.tip: The yo form of any regular verb always ends in -o.

questions.q: What is the tú form of 'hablar'?
questions.why_correct: The tú form of -AR verbs ends in -as. Habl- + -as = hablas.
questions.tip: The tú form of -AR verbs ends in -as.

questions.q: What is the él/ella form of 'hablar'?
questions.why_correct: The él/ella form of -AR verbs ends in -a. Habl- + -a = habla.
questions.tip: The él/ella form of -AR verbs ends in -a.

questions.q: What is the nosotros form of 'hablar'?
questions.why_correct: The nosotros form of -AR verbs ends in -amos. Habl- + -amos = hablamos.
questions.tip: The nosotros form of -AR verbs ends in -amos.

questions.q: What is the ellos form of 'hablar'?
questions.why_correct: The ellos/ellas form of -AR verbs ends in -an. Habl- + -an = hablan.
questions.tip: The ellos/ellas form of -AR verbs ends in -an.
